name: Language Model Chat (relay)
description: One chat turn with a PAID language model (xAI Grok, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI or Google Gemini; xai by default), relayed so the caller never holds the key: the key stays in the owner's vault. Off until the owner switches the provider on and sets a daily cap (Settings > Language models); refused with the reason when off, keyless or capped. max_tokens up to 16,000; continue_if_cut asks once more when an answer stops at max_tokens and joins the two. Returns text (up to 64,000 characters), model, usage (tokens, cost) and a truncated flag.
requires: the owner's llm_provider_<name>_enabled switch and an llm_daily_cap_<name> above 0, for the provider used
that provider's key in the vault: XAI_API_KEY, CLAUDE_WORKSPACE_API, OPENAI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY
